videorotate.drop: Drop a video here, or click to choose one
videorotate.label.preview: Preview — this is exactly what comes out
videorotate.status.idle: The video stays in your browser — nothing is uploaded anywhere.
videorotate.say.ready: Rotate it, and record once the preview looks right.
videorotate.err.open: Could not open this video. Try another file.
videorotate.err.unsupported: This browser cannot record video. Try Chrome or Edge.
videorotate.say.recording: Recording… keep this tab in front.
videorotate.say.doneHidden: It finished, but you switched tabs partway — that stretch may be a frozen frame. Recording it again is safer.
videorotate.say.done: Recorded. Go ahead and download it.
